profile.description: One NVIDIA L4 (24 GB, sm_89) on Vast.ai, PocketTTS English 24L (english_2026-04_24l) streaming on the CUDA server. C160 is the qualified operating point: two independent 30-minute soaks on the v2 corpus, 184.5 audio-s/s, RTF p95 0.855-0.857, TTFA p95 154-155 ms, 0 stalls, 0 failures, WER 2.02/1.94% against 1.87% for an unloaded C8 control (2026-09-28 defaults, bf16 KV). The CUDA defaults now add the shared voice prefix, split decode attention, bf16 backbone Linears (cuBLASLt, fused), the fused decoder, one sync per frame, the per-request device memory diet and (since 2026-10-04) int8 backbone KV; with them the server runs at --max-batch 320 (2-min closed-loop screens, v2 corpus, 4 voices: RTF p95 0.681 at C256, 0.782 at C288, 0.855 at C320, 335-345 audio-s/s, 0 stalls, peak VRAM 16.3 GB). Soak qualification of those defaults is pending, so C160 below is still the qualified point. NOT the shipped default: one host thread is exported. Host-scoped: another GPU is another profile.

hardware.canonical_topology: one process: 8 HTTP workers in front of one CUDA scheduler thread; no prefork
hardware.notes: Vast.ai instance, load generator on the same host. The host is not the limit: pinned to 4 cores (taskset -c 0-3, a 4-vCPU host) the server lost 1.5% at C64 (123.5 -> 121.7 audio-s/s) using 110% of 400% CPU. The server's CPU is ~110-125% of one core, mostly one scheduler thread spinning in cudaStreamSynchronize, so 4 vCPUs are enough for one L4.

requirements.cuda_arch: sm_89 explicitly: CUDA_ARCH=native is for local bring-up, never a portable artifact (tools/gpu/provision.sh defaults to native).

server.why: One process, --max-batch = --max-inflight = C so every admitted stream is in the batch and the GPU runs one gang per step. 320 is the screening ceiling of the 2026-10-04 defaults (int8 backbone KV). 2-min closed-loop knees, v2 corpus, 4 voices (alba, marius, javert, jean), seed 1234, --max-batch = the top level, same build, KV the only change: bf16 KV C256 RTF p95 0.745, 314.6 audio-s/s, TTFA p95 129 ms; C288 0.827, 315.9 audio-s/s, TTFA p95 143 ms; peak VRAM 21.3 GB at --max-batch 288. int8 KV C256 0.681, 345.4 audio-s/s, TTFA p95 118 ms; C288 0.782, 334.8 audio-s/s, TTFA p95 134 ms; C320 0.855, 338.4 audio-s/s, TTFA p95 146 ms; peak VRAM 16.3 GB at --max-batch 320, ready in 52 s. 0 stalls@250/500 and 0 failures at every level; audio seconds per request equal between the two modes (no EOS drift). Soak qualification pending. The qualified C160 point below was measured with --max-batch 160 on the 2026-09-28 defaults, where the knee ladder (25 s per level) was flat at ~138 audio-s/s from C128 with RTF p95 linear in C (0.71/0.78/0.86/0.93/0.99 at C128/144/160/176/192). 8 HTTP workers is the harness default (tools/gpu/serve.sh); the server needs ~1.1-1.25 host cores.

MYNAH_THREADS.why: Required: NOT the default (the pool otherwise sizes itself to every allowed CPU, 128 on this host). On CUDA the hot stages are resident on the device and the host pool has nothing hot to run; every point below was measured with 1 (tools/gpu/serve.sh).

MYNAH_CUDA_KV_DTYPE.why: Must be ABSENT (default int8 since 2026-10-04, when the resident backbone, the prefill tile and the shared voice prefix with strip are on and heads are 64 wide). Backbone KV rows store int8 values with one float scale per position and head (1088 instead of 2048 bytes per position and plane on 24L); the shared voice prefix stays bf16. L4 2-min knees vs bf16 KV (same build): C256 RTF p95 0.745 -> 0.681, 314.6 -> 345.4 audio-s/s; C288 0.827 -> 0.782; peak VRAM 21.3 GB (max-batch 288) -> 16.3 GB (max-batch 320); audio seconds per request unchanged. No WER run on this change; the soak qualification will carry it. =bf16 is the rollback (and keeps rows without a shared model-voice KV, i.e. a voice that is not an entry of the pack, on the GPU: with int8 they run their backbone on the CPU); =f32 is the CPU/GPU parity oracle. The qualified C160 point below was measured with bf16.

MYNAH_QUANT_GROUPS.why: Pinned to what every point was measured with. Since the 2026-09-27 trap fix it is also what a resident CUDA build resolves 'default' to (src/engine_pocket.c: raw f32 weights), so it no longer changes the run; it stays explicit because before that fix an unset variable inherited the CPU bf16/f16 groups and ran backbone, flow and Mimi on the CPU oracle while the server said device=cuda (C1 RTF 8.7). Any other spec now refuses to start unless MYNAH_CUDA_ALLOW_CPU_STAGES=1. It does not turn off the bf16 backbone default: the groups select int8 encodings, and the f32 groups ('none' = all of them) are what MYNAH_CUDA_QUANT upgrades to bf16.

MYNAH_SERVE_PROFILE.why: Instrumentation only: the scheduler's occupancy/step counters, printed at shutdown (src/inference.c). Exported by tools/gpu/serve.sh for every point below, so it is part of what was measured; it does not change the audio.

MYNAH_CUDA_ALLOW_CPU_STAGES.why: Must be ABSENT: it lets a CUDA server run a hot stage (backbone, flow, Mimi) on the CPU oracle, 20-30x slower, while reporting device=cuda.

MYNAH_CUDA_MIMI_TILE.why: Must be ABSENT (default on). Cross-request Mimi tile: C8 2.9 -> 10.3 audio-s/s, RTF p95 1.76 -> 0.85 (L4, 24L, 2026-09-27). =0 is the rollback to the per-request resident Mimi schedule.

MYNAH_CUDA_PREFILL_TILE.why: Must be ABSENT (default on). Batched prefill tile + device voice cache: C32 8.5 -> 30.5 audio-s/s, prefill slices ~160 ms -> ~1.5 ms. =0 is the rollback to the host-seeded token-by-token prefill; MYNAH_CUDA_KV_GROW also depends on the tile.

MYNAH_CUDA_TF32.why: Must be ABSENT (default on). TF32 tensor cores for the cuBLAS FP32 GEMMs: C32 22.0 -> 27.7 audio-s/s (ABAB), RTF p95 0.95 -> 0.73; WER gate passed against the CPU f32 oracle. =0 is the rollback to strict FP32 cuBLAS.

MYNAH_CUDA_TILE_SPLITK.why: Must be ABSENT (default on). Split-K in the fixed-order tile GEMM: measured neutral (~26 -> ~27 audio-s/s at C32) and kept. =0 is the rollback to the unsplit kernel.

MYNAH_CUDA_TILE_CUBLAS.why: Must be ABSENT (default on). The Mimi tile GEMM through cuBLAS: C48 43.9 -> 58.1 audio-s/s, RTF p95 0.76 -> 0.55. =0 is the rollback to the fixed-order SIMT tile GEMM.

MYNAH_CUDA_TILE_ATTN_GROUPED.why: Must be ABSENT (default on). Grouped shared-memory tile attention. Its only A/B was noisy and read 48.7 -> 43.9 audio-s/s at C48 ('default, re-check' on the 2026-09-27 board); every qualified point ran with it on. =0 is the rollback to the ungrouped kernel; the re-check is still owed.

MYNAH_CUDA_DECODER_CONVTR_GEMM.why: Must be ABSENT (default on). SEANet ConvTranspose as one GEMM: C48 24.5 -> 48.7 audio-s/s, RTF p95 1.06 -> 0.67. =0 is the rollback to the per-tap kernel.

MYNAH_CUDA_CODEC_GANG.why: Must be ABSENT (default on). One quantizer projection + upsample and one PCM D2H for the whole gang: C8 6.46 -> 7.74 audio-s/s, RTF p95 1.09 -> 0.97 (measured on the agent branch, old base). =0 restores the per-request schedule exactly.

MYNAH_CUDA_BACKBONE_ATTN.why: Must be ABSENT (default: the chunked online-softmax decode attention). +22-30%: C64 98.0 -> 119.4 audio-s/s, RTF p95 0.489 -> 0.431, TTFA p95 98 -> 87 ms; self-check PASS with both kernels. =legacy (not =0) is the rollback to the per-position tree-reduction kernel.

MYNAH_CUDA_DECODER_GRAPH_REUSE.why: Must be ABSENT (default on). One SEANet decoder graph per width, re-recorded instead of re-captured: C64 96.7 -> 98.8 audio-s/s (+2%), 568 captures / 206 replays -> 10 / 826. =0 is the rollback to one graph per exact gang.

MYNAH_CUDA_SLOT_POOL.why: Must be ABSENT (default on). max_batch resource sets created at start-up instead of allocating on the scheduler thread: C64 119.1 -> 123.5 audio-s/s unpinned (+3.7%), 116.4 -> 121.7 on 4 cores (+4.6%); md5-identical leak test with the pool off and on. =0 is the rollback to per-request allocation.

MYNAH_CUDA_KV_GROW.why: Must be ABSENT (default on). Device backbone KV grown in 256-position chunks: VRAM C64 13.2 -> 6.8 GB, C96 18.9 -> 9.2 GB, C128 OOM -> 11.5 GB (-48%); md5-identical to full capacity. =0 is the rollback to worst-case allocation, which OOMs at C128 on this GPU, so this profile cannot run without it.

MYNAH_CUDA_PREFILL_FIXED.why: Must be ABSENT (default: fixed-order prefill; with the bf16 backbone default that is the bf16 tensor-core tile, MYNAH_CUDA_PREFILL_BF16TC). =0 routes the prefill tile through cuBLAS (bf16 on bf16 weights, TF32 on f32): on f32 weights +4-9% (C64 127.3 -> 133.0, C96 130.4 -> 141.8 audio-s/s) and -7% RTF p95 at C160-C208 (2026-10-02), but the long-form self-check fails (text pushed in pieces vs whole differs), i.e. it loses piecewise-prefill identity. Opt-in only: determinism vs throughput is a product decision.

MYNAH_CUDA_TILE_TC.why: Must be ABSENT (default off). WMMA TF32 fixed-order tile GEMM: -25% without split-K (C64 127.6 -> 95.4), +1-2% with it (127.3 -> 128.4 at C64); invariant but far from cuBLAS. Opt-in experiment; it only concerns f32-weight prefill (MYNAH_CUDA_QUANT=f32).

MYNAH_CUDA_SYNC.why: Must be ABSENT (default: the driver's auto schedule, which spins). blocking: C64 97.7 -> 88.9 audio-s/s (-9%) for 117% -> 43% server CPU; yield: -1% with no CPU saved. Each wake-up leaves the GPU idle.

MYNAH_CUDA_QUANT.why: Must be ABSENT (default bf16 for the Pocket CUDA engine since 2026-10-02: FlowLM backbone Linears read BF16 weight copies with fp32 accumulate, MYNAH_CUDA_QUANT_STAGES default backbone; residual stream, norms, flow head, EOS head and codec stay fp32). L4 60-s knees, all other 2026-10-02 defaults on: TF32 f32 weights -> bf16 backbone with MYNAH_CUDA_BF16_FUSE and MYNAH_CUDA_BF16_LT: C208 RTF p95 0.676 -> 0.607, C256 0.788 -> 0.714, 266 -> 303 audio-s/s, TTFA p95 C208 115 -> 104 ms. =f32 is the rollback to fp32/TF32 weights everywhere (the C160 point below was measured that way); int8 is diagnostic.

MYNAH_CUDA_SEANET_BF16.why: Must be ABSENT (default on). SEANet decoder convolution GEMMs with BF16 operands and FP32 accumulate; states, ELU, residuals and audio stay FP32. L4 A/B/A/B (60-s closed loop, v2 corpus, 4 voices): C160 RTF p95 0.855/0.875 -> 0.832/0.837, 152-156 -> 162 audio-s/s; C192 0.874 -> 0.845. Temperature 0 vs FP32: SNR 47.5-49 dB (tests/codec_int8_quality.py --mode seanet-bf16). =0 is the rollback to the FP32 decoder GEMMs (byte-identical to v1.5.0).

MYNAH_CUDA_SLOT_POOL_PREFILL.why: Must be ABSENT (default on, CUDA). The slot pool is filled at start-up with --max-batch resource sets, so a fresh server's first burst runs like a warm one. =0 is the rollback to filling on first use.

MYNAH_CUDA_WIDTH_BUCKETS.why: Must be ABSENT (default on, CUDA). Gang widths rounded up to buckets whose graphs are captured at start-up: no graph capture during traffic. Start-up 2 s -> 33 s on the L4 (24L, --max-batch 160). =0 is the rollback to exact widths captured on first use.

MYNAH_CUDA_QUANT_STAGES.why: Must be ABSENT (default backbone). =all adds bf16 flow head and Mimi transformer: no measurable gain (C256 0.714 -> 0.712, 303 -> 305 audio-s/s), not a default.

MYNAH_CUDA_BF16_FUSE.why: Must be ABSENT (default on). Fused bf16 decode layers: LayerNorm/GELU/attention write the bf16 GEMM operand, biases folded into the consumers; 456 -> 264 graph nodes per 24-layer step, bit-identical to the unfused bf16 path (--gpu-self-test checks the kernels bitwise). =0 is the rollback.

MYNAH_CUDA_BF16_LT.why: Must be ABSENT (default on). bf16 Linears through cuBLASLt with a per-shape heuristic algorithm (created only when bf16 weights are in use): without it cublasGemmEx picked small bf16 tiles and the bf16 backbone was 10% slower than TF32. =0 is the rollback to cublasGemmEx.

MYNAH_CUDA_PREFILL_BF16TC.why: Must be ABSENT (default on for bf16 weights). Fixed-order prefill tile on bf16 tensor cores: keeps text-in-pieces == text-whole bit for bit at bf16 weight traffic. =0 is the rollback to the SIMT bf16 tile; =1 explicitly also applies it to f32 weights.

MYNAH_CUDA_SHARED_VOICE.why: Must be ABSENT (default on). Decode attention reads each row's voice prefix from the shared device voice cache, and (MYNAH_CUDA_SHARED_VOICE_STRIP, default on) rows do not store it (~12 MB less per row). L4 A/B, 2 rounds: C160 0.811/0.818 -> 0.731/0.733, C192 0.947/0.949 -> 0.845/0.847, C208 1.031/1.038 (stalls) -> 0.921/0.922 (0 stalls), 163 -> 185 audio-s/s; bit-identical audio. =0 is the rollback.

MYNAH_CUDA_SHARED_VOICE_STRIP.why: Must be ABSENT (default on under MYNAH_CUDA_SHARED_VOICE). =0 keeps the voice prefix copied into every row (phase 1), for A/B; it removes the VRAM headroom C224+ needs.

MYNAH_CUDA_ATTN_SPLIT.why: Must be ABSENT (default on). Split (flash-decoding) bf16 decode attention: C208 0.705 -> 0.674, C224 0.745 -> 0.711, C240 0.787 -> 0.749, 250 -> 267 audio-s/s at C240. Deterministic and batch-invariant; last-bit differences vs the fast kernel (self-test max rel diff 5e-7). =0 is the rollback.

MYNAH_CUDA_DECODER_FUSE.why: Must be ABSENT (default on). SEANet gang decoder: ELU, causal window, residual add, conv bias (MYNAH_CUDA_DECODER_FUSE_BIAS, default on with it) and the transposed-conv fold folded into the kernels that read them: 36 -> 20 elementwise launches per step, bit-identical audio (temperature-0 runs 99 dB). =0 is the rollback.

MYNAH_CUDA_ONE_SYNC.why: Must be ABSENT (default on). Condition, backbone, EOS and flow head share one stream sync per batched frame (3 fewer per frame); same audio. =0 is the rollback to one sync per stage.

MYNAH_CUDA_KV_VMM.why: Must be ABSENT (default off). KV rows as VMM ranges that grow in place; ignored with int8 KV (it needs MYNAH_CUDA_KV_DTYPE=bf16). With bf16 KV and the diet it fit C320 in 14.4 GB but its position-major layout cost ~4 % and C320 was compute-bound (RTF p95 0.926); int8 KV reaches C320 at 0.855 without it.

soak.bank_version: v2 corpus, 300 distinct English utterances (short / conversational / medium / long, drawn .25/.35/.28/.12), deterministic by seed

qualification.model: models/pocket-english-24l (kyutai/pocket-tts english_2026-04_24l, revision 75cfe24e3142233bb81887fed3482e9652bb4a6e, converted by tools/convert_pocket.py with the default --dtype bf16; the F32 source pack measured equal on WER and throughput)
qualification.workload: v2 corpus, four voices drawn per request, streaming route, closed loop saturated at C, load generator (tools/pocket_ladder.py) on the same host, 30 s warm-up, ten 180 s windows. Qualified by tools/gpu/qualify.sh: two independent 30-minute soaks on freshly started servers with different seeds, audio captured from the live streams and transcribed. Every 10th request captured; WER by faster-whisper small.en (CPU int8).

operating_point.evidence: l4:/root/evidence/bundles/pocket-24l-c160-final (private evidence bundle, not published), soak B

ceiling.why_not_promoted: RTF p95 0.926 fails the 0.90 preferred gate. Throughput is flat at ~138 audio-s/s from C128 up (GPU saturated) and RTF p95 grows linearly in C, so a higher level only buys latency.
RTF p95 0.992: still below 1.0 but with no margin at all; realtime is about to break.

qualification.notes: C60-C64 on 2026-09-27 (all CUDA defaults, one 250 ms hiccup in 30 minutes) -> backbone attention rewrite +22-30%, slot pool, decoder graph reuse, tile workspace grow-only -> C96 GOOD 176.8 audio-s/s -> KV grow (-48% VRAM) -> C128 GOOD 186.7 -> 256-wide cap -> C160 qualified by two soaks with captured audio (WER A 2.02%, B 1.94%; unloaded C8 control on soak A's request ids 1.87%, same per-voice profile: alba ~0.4%, marius ~4.7%). The load does not degrade the audio; the voice spread is the model/voice pair. The C96/C128 soaks used the built-in text mix, the C160 soaks the v2 corpus. Detail: .work/pocket-cuda-l4-host-cpu.md and docs/performance.md (2026-09-28). The 6L on the same box is l4-24g-pocket-en-6l-cuda.json.
